simple.meaning: נֹקֵד (nôqêd) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 3:4. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֹקֵד (H5349) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
